description: Dual band stereo width processor with VU meter: the input is split at a crossover frequency and the stereo width and level of the low and high bands are set separately

params.text: Sets the frequency at which the input splits into a low band and a high band, 50Hz to 500Hz
Sets the crossover slope to 12dB per octave or 24dB per octave
Sets the stereo width of the low band, 0% collapsing it to mono, 100% leaving it as it came in and 200% doubling it
Sets the stereo width of the high band, 0% collapsing it to mono, 100% leaving it as it came in and 200% doubling it
Silences the high band so that only the low band reaches the output, and switching it on clears the high band solo
Silences the low band so that only the high band reaches the output, and switching it on clears the low band solo
Sets the level of the low band, -20dB to +20dB
Sets the level of the high band, -20dB to +20dB
Passes the input to the output unprocessed
Sets the level of the processed signal, -20dB to +20dB
Crossfades the output between the untouched input at 0% and the fully processed signal at 100%

inputs.text: Adds to the low band width setting, each volt shifting it by 20 percentage points
Adds to the high band width setting, each volt shifting it by 20 percentage points

menu: Poly input behavior — Sum each input (L, R) adds the channels of each poly input on its own, Sum to stereo (L only) reads one poly cable in the left input as a stereo mix
Display colour — picks the colour of the value readouts
VU scaling — Scale as track calibrates the meter so 0dB is 5V, Scale as master so 0dB is 10V
VU colour — picks the colour of the meter
